body_markdown:
*Leaders from Alkami and Thomaston Savings Bank will discuss how financial institutions can use[predictive AI](https://www.alkami.com/data-marketing-solutions/predictive-ai/) and behavioral signals to drive strategic growth and strengthen account holder relationships*


**October 23, 2026 (Plano, Texas) –** Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced an upcoming webinar hosted with[Thomaston Savings Bank](https://www.thomastonsavingsbank.com/) , “[Guess Less and Grow More with Predictive AI](https://my.demio.com/ref/SCWuiIdbNOazW8K5) .” The webinar will take place Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 2 p.m. ET.


As account holders increasingly expect more personalized and proactive experiences, financial institutions have an opportunity to leverage data to deliver tailored guidance during every interaction. According to Alkami research, 44% of Americans who use digital banking wish their primary financial provider did a better job anticipating their financial needs and goals.1


The upcoming webinar will explore how financial institutions can respond to these expectations by using[predictive artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.alkami.com/data-marketing-solutions/predictive-ai/) to drive growth across deposits and lending while strengthening primary relationships. Speakers will discuss how[Alkami’s Data & Marketing Solution](https://www.alkami.com/data-marketing-solutions/) uses behavioral insights and predictive AI to help institutions identify growth opportunities and deliver more personalized outreach.


**Featured speakers include:**


- [Kent Blacksher](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kentblacksher/) , strategic account executive, Alkami
- [Ethan O’Day](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ethan-oday/) , business intelligence analyst, Thomaston Savings Bank


“Data helps us understand how customers engage, but the real value comes from understanding what those behaviors may tell us about their needs,” said Ethan O’Day, business intelligence analyst, Thomaston Savings Bank. “Predictive AI can help us focus our outreach sooner and make it more relevant, while our team’s expertise keeps the work grounded in the relationships we have with our customers.”


During the session, attendees will learn how to:


- Identify deposit and lending opportunities using behavioral signals
- Create more relevant outreach for customers and members
- Recognize engagement and attrition signals earlier
- Simplify campaign execution and move from insight to action
- Build marketing strategies that support growth and retention


The presentation will explore real examples of how data-activated campaigns drive faster product adoption, along with insights into how predictive AI can help guide your team’s strategy.


“Financial institutions have more data than ever, but data creates value when teams can turn insight into action,” said Kent Blacksher, strategic account executive at Alkami. “Combining predictive AI with human expertise allows marketing teams to skip the guesswork while building stronger account holder relationships.”


To register for the webinar, visit[here](https://my.demio.com/ref/SCWuiIdbNOazW8K5) .


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room/) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.
